standard_prerequisites.name: The projection formula for a first Chern class against proper pushforward, and commutativity on an integral scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-pushforward-cap-c1 (proof line 5027, claimed as S14-algebra-pushforward-cap-c1) and lemma-commutativity-on-integral (proof line 5035)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first moves the caps through the proper morphism from the disjoint union of the components, and the second settles the integral case.

core_obligations: Reduce to integral components: write the class as a locally finite sum of integral closed subschemes, form the disjoint union with its proper morphism to X, and use the projection formula twice to rewrite both sides as pushforwards from that union (proof lines 5020-5032).
Conclude in the integral case by the commutativity statement and the definitions (proof lines 5033-5035).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the disjoint union of the components (proof lines 5020-5032).
Integral case via the commutativity statement (proof lines 5033-5035).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the caps with the first Chern classes of two invertible sheaves commute (statement lines 5006-5018, tag 02TZ-adjacent). The proof reduces to the case of an integral scheme by passing to the disjoint union of the integral components with the projection formula, and then invokes the commutativity statement on an integral scheme. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
